name: yandex-metrica-mcp
description: Query your Yandex Metrica web analytics — reports, conversions, and raw logs — from an AI agent. Read-only unless you turn on the write tools.

counter_id.title: Counter ID
counter_id.description: Default Yandex Metrica counter id (optional — tools also take a counterId, and the login tool lists your counters).

token.title: Static OAuth token
token.description: Optional. Leave empty and sign in with the login tool. For CI/non-interactive use, paste a metrika:read token — stored in your OS keychain.

enable_write.title: Enable write tools
enable_write.description: Adds tools that change the counter (chart annotations, expense upload). Sign-in then also asks for write access, and you confirm every change.
